rows.text: "Welcome, [Trailblazer]. Stephen asked me to give you a thorough breakdown of those 'custom dice'." Herta doesn't seem to be in the mood to explain much. "According to him, the die is actually a shell of an Intellitron, and you can attach your emotions, thoughts, memories, and charms to it."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: So, this die is an Intellitron?
It's just a customizable die...
"I don't know." Herta shrugs. "Just enjoy it, and maybe it'll develop its own free will someday."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Yeah, that's it," Herta replies. "Just enjoy it and give your feedback to Stephen."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Keep going, [Trailblazer]." Herta says, turning the screen off.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You're back. What do you think?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Hi, [Trailblazer]. I was appointed by Miss Pearl, P-45 to discuss our cooperation with Madam Herta on behalf of the Strategic Investment Department.
rows.speaker: Little Robot

rows.text: It's fun.
I don't see much difference.
Who's this beside you...
As expected.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Well, you can give Stephen your feedback.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: This is our guest from the Strategic Investment Department of IPC.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: We heard that the Simulated Universe would do research on The First Emperor's War next. Miss Pearl is quite interested, as the Emperor's War happened in the same era when the Borderstar Trade War took place.
rows.speaker: Little Robot

rows.text: The Strategic Investment Department is relatively new compared to other departments in IPC, so we have no first-hand experience of that history. Now, the best and brightest of our department are traveling around the galaxy to settle bad debts stemming from the Cancer of All Worlds. We need more historical data for that.
rows.speaker: Little Robot

rows.text: We'd like to support the Simulated Universe project and purchase the derivation data related to the IPC.
rows.speaker: Little Robot

rows.text: Who is Pearl?
The Simulated Universe is that famous?
No idea. Screwllum seems to have mentioned it before, so it's likely to be an Intellitron.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Of course.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Frankly, the Emperor's War was so long ago that I don't think it'll be any help to modern investment — Unless they've run out of things to gossip about in the office and just want to read about the IPC back when it was first established.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Or... Forget it. I'm not interested in corporate conflicts.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Since they're willing to pay for it, I see no reason to stop. This is an interesting proposal, so I'll say yes. Do your best and keep collecting IPC secrets.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Hm?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: About the Swarm Disaster...
About Gold and Gears...
That's all. See you soon.
What kind of questions do you have?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: How will I learn of Propagation's secrets?
I still have some questions...

Continue along the Trail of Pathstrider, and walk along the traces already paved by those who came before you, and try your hardest to get closer to the Aeons! Don't worry! Just carry out the Paths in the way you want to.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: What kind of questions do you have?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: How will I learn of Erudition's secrets?
I still have some questions...

Hmm, good question. Pay close attention to your Intra-Cognition at all times to prevent yourself from becoming a robot or totally losing your rationality. Don't think too much. You'll eventually end up following THEIR calculations anyways.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Don't forget to test my Simulated Universe!
rows.speaker: Herta
